title: R as a client: Define ellmer tools from MCP servers — client
text: remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers, configure server url. Static headers can supplied headers; protocol-owned headers Accept, Content-Type, MCP-Session-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version managed mcptools configured manually. Credentialed public remote endpoints must use HTTPS. HTTP allowed loopback development servers, explicit unsafe opt-allow_http. Remote server entries support fields: url: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. headers: named static headers. Values may use ${ENVVAR} interpolation. timeout: number seconds overall HTTP request timeout. allow_http: allow credentialed non-loopback HTTP endpoints. ignore_tools: tool names * wildcards hide block. oauth: OAuth settings. OAuth settings may include authorization_server, resource, scope scope_mode = "override", client_info, manual_client_info, client_metadata, redirect_uri callback_host/callback_port/ callback_path, cache_dir, allow_http. mcptools supports OAuth 2.1 PKCE: discovers authorization server protected-resource metadata advertised 401 challenge, registers client dynamically server supports , caches tokens (refreshing automatically). Remote HTTP requests use httr2 curl. Proxy corporate CA settings generally use standard curl environment variables, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY, SSL_CERT_FILE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE. Stdio server processes inherit variables mcptools' default environment allowlist.

title: mcptools 1.0.0
text: New features: mcptools can now run Posit Connect R API engine. Add _server.yml engine: mcptools, point tools .R file returning ellmer::tool() objects, deploy rsconnect::deployAPI(".", contentCategory = "mcp"). mcp_server() can now return inline image content tools produce ellmer::ContentImageInline results, including mixed text image content (#96, #102). mcp_server() now returns structuredContent alongside serialized JSON text successful tool results naturally represented JSON objects, using MCP protocol version 2025-06-18 later (#104). mcp_server() now includes ellmer tool annotations tools/list responses, preserving MCP safety hints title, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint (#100, #105). Bug fixes: HTTP mcp_server() requests now honor MCP-Protocol-Version header, return 400 Bad Request unsupported protocol versions, longer let protocol negotiation one HTTP client shape responses another. JSON output now serializes R NULL values JSON null, fixing JSON-RPC responses null request IDs. mcp_server() longer falls reporting Invalid Request invalid stdio client messages. Forwarded mcp_session() tool calls now return JSON-RPC errors selected R session respond within two minutes, rather hanging indefinitely. Configure timeout mcptools.session_response_timeout_seconds option MCPTOOLS_SESSION_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS environment variable. Session receive errors also logged instead silently discarded (#98).

title: mcptools 1.0.0
text: New features: mcp_tools() can now connect directly remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers, configured url instead command. Static headers supported token auth, full OAuth 2.1 (authorization-server discovery, Dynamic Client Registration, PKCE, automatic token refresh) handled via httr2, also caches tokens across sessions (#88). mcp_tools() now converts MCP tool-result content blocks ellmer-native text image content, allowing ellmer chats receive image results MCP tools. Bug fixes: mcp_tools() now launches MCP server processes allowlisted environment plus configured env variables. Previously, servers without configured env inherited full R process environment, servers configured env received variables. new behavior closely matches reference MCP SDKs, reduces accidental credential exposure, fixes Windows startup failures env configured. Servers need additional non-allowlisted variables list env (#62).
